description: This PHP class 'RequestBodySubscriber' is an event subscriber for Symfony's HTTP kernel events. It listens to request events and, if the request's content type is JSON, decodes the JSON content and adds it to the request parameters.

classes.name: RequestBodySubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that processes incoming HTTP requests, parses JSON payloads, and injects the data into request parameters.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events this subscriber listens to, specifically Symfony's KernelREQUEST event with a high priority.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event, checks for JSON content type, decodes JSON payload, and adds it to the request parameters.
